title: Unfolded gate size is polarity-independent
statement: Let $g$ be any gate, and let $t$ assign a Boolean circuit tree to each vertex and polarity. Suppose that at every vertex the assigned tree has the same size for both polarities. Then unfolding $g$ at either of two polarities gives trees of equal size.
hypotheses_covered: A tree assignment indexed by vertices and Boolean polarities
The assigned tree size is independent of polarity at every vertex
